argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root='E:\WebAIBridge'; $data='E:\WebAIBridge\app\data'; $base='http://127.0.0.1:17448'
Write-Output ('GIT_HEAD='+[string](& git.exe -C $root rev-parse HEAD))
Write-Output ('TRACKED_DIRTY='+@(& git.exe -C $root status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=no).Count)
$s=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($base+'/api/supervisor-watchdog?detect=0') -TimeoutSec 12
$d=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($base+'/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments/dry-run') -TimeoutSec 12
$q=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($base+'/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments') -TimeoutSec 12
$l=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($base+'/api/operator-lifecycle') -TimeoutSec 12
$state=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $data 'state.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
$r42=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $data 'projects-live-control-plane-cutover-r42.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
Write-Output ('LIFECYCLE='+$l.mode)
Write-Output ('QUEUE_PAUSED='+$state.settings.paused)
Write-Output ('R42_HOLD='+$r42.holdActive)
Write-Output ('ALLOW_AUTONOMOUS_SEND='+$s.config.allowAutonomousSend)
Write-Output ('AUTO_CONTINUE='+$s.config.autoContinueEnabled)
Write-Output ('OPEN_MISSING='+$s.config.openExistingChatIfMissing)
Write-Output ('HIGH_ENFORCED='+$s.config.enforceHighMode)
Write-Output ('PARALLEL='+$s.config.maxParallelAgents)
Write-Output ('UNSETTLED='+@($q.assignments|Where-Object{$_.state -in @('queued','dispatching','running','awaiting_evidence','unknown')}).Count)
Write-Output ('ASSIGNMENT_TOTAL='+@($q.assignments).Count)
Write-Output ('DRYRUN_SEND_ATTEMPTED='+$d.sendAttempted)
Write-Output ('DRYRUN_WOULD_DISPATCH='+@($d.rows|Where-Object{$_.wouldDispatch -eq $true}).Count)
Write-Output ('DRYRUN_READY='+@($d.rows|Where-Object{$_.preflightReason -eq 'ready'}).Count)
Write-Output ('BACKUP_EXISTS='+(Test-Path 'E:\WebAIBridge-R65-SAFETY-BACKUP-20261014-GPT6-I1\BACKUP_MANIFEST.json'))
Write-Output 'READ_ONLY_DONE'

note: Read-only status of owner-managed bridge feature holds; no mutation, provider sends, credentials, or tab changes.
